source: AI Engineering from Scratch phase map aligned to TomorrowAI Course Core
alignment_policy: Use AI Engineering from Scratch as a Tier 1 build-depth track, not as a replacement for the TomorrowAI course spine.

phases.name: Setup & Tooling
phases.tomorrowai_module: Course environment, Cursor/Codex, Git, Python/TypeScript setup

phases.name: Math Foundations
phases.pulse_use: Pull only the math needed for today's build
phases.activate_when: Vectors, gradients, probability, optimization, or matrix calculus block implementation

phases.name: ML Fundamentals
phases.pulse_use: Use Microsoft ML-For-Beginners if fundamentals are weak
phases.activate_when: Regression, classification, clustering, or Scikit-learn concepts block progress

phases.name: Deep Learning Core
phases.pulse_use: Use for from-scratch neural net understanding
phases.activate_when: Transformer or LLM internals require deep learning review

phases.name: Transformers
phases.pulse_use: Pair with LLMs-from-scratch and attention implementation
phases.activate_when: Attention, tokenization, context, or transformer architecture blocks work

phases.name: LLMs from Scratch
phases.pulse_use: Deep reinforcement track for LLM architecture
phases.activate_when: Need to understand Q/K/V, pretraining loop, inference, or fine-tuning concepts

phases.name: LLM Engineering
phases.activate_when: Building prompts, structured outputs, RAG, tool calling, or production LLM features

phases.name: Tools & Protocols
phases.activate_when: Building MCP tools, function calling, or external tool integrations

phases.name: Agent Engineering
phases.tomorrowai_module: Agents, planning, tool use, recovery, evaluation
phases.activate_when: Building agents with planning, tools, memory, or evals

phases.name: Infrastructure & Production
phases.tomorrowai_module: Deployment, observability, local inference, evaluation, safety
phases.activate_when: Shipping to Vercel, adding evals, monitoring, or local inference

phases.name: Capstone Projects
phases.activate_when: Ready to build public portfolio/demo system
